title: Image Processor
description: Implement image processing methods through editing pixels in a Processor Template. Simulate a monetized app using inheritance. Implement a KNN classifier to predict the labels of images.

title: Power Outages Analysis
description: Access and examine an online dataset of major power outages in the U.S.. Generate visualizations of the data using plotly. Build a predictive model for the cause of major power outages using sklearn RandomForestClassifier.

title: Amazon Product and User Rating Analysis Project
description: Analyze the dataset from Amazon.com in the pyspark environment, which contains 9.34 million pieces of data on products and user ratings. Select, process raw data and convert it into features that can be used for machine learning, such as word2vec and one-hot encoding.

title: Meteorite Impact Analysis
description: The research includes a database of meteorite impacts that occurred globally.

title: Personal Asset Map
description: Draw the personal asset map for future community engagements

title: Composite Story Comic Strip
description: Tell a composite story to promote social justice of equal access

title: Collaborative Genre Project
description: We make a data dashboard to explore relationship between electrical vehicles usage and CO2 emissions
